claim_text: Evidence on melatonin supplementation during pregnancy is limited; it should not be recommended routinely during pregnancy without individualized obstetric review.
health_goal_or_outcome: Identify safety constraints and prevent unsupported supplement recommendations.
ingredient_form_or_preparation: Supplement products; verify exact formulation, concentration and label.
evidence_summary: NCCIH melatonin resources describe evidence limitations; pregnancy-specific safety evidence remains limited.
limitations: Exact source passages, product-specific labeling and clinical applicability require full appraisal.
